data: Which of the following methods has the mean probability of token decrease in the window of indices 5 to 25?

The caption states that when teacher-forcing the model on human text, probability increases slowly. When generating with top-k sampling, probability increases faster, especially for smaller k. The figure shows three lines representing different methods: Top-k sampling with k=5, Top-k sampling with k=20, and Teacher-force on human text. The y-axis represents the mean probability of token, and the x-axis represents the token index. The caption also mentions that this pattern holds for both Fusion Model and GPT2-117. Therefore, the method with the mean probability of token decrease in the window of indices 5 to 25 is Teacher-force on human text.
